messages:
Marta: Anyone else seeing missing pages? Customer reported they didn't get an oncall page at ~03:12. incident-bot didn't create a thread for that alert.
Alex: I'm seeing 5xx from pager-proxy -> relay. Queue backlog spiking. quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:02Z pager-proxy ERROR relay request failed status=503 id=ab12 msg_count=12400
2026-03-17T03:12:03Z pager-proxy WARN queue oldest=00:34:21 backlog=12387
```
InfraBot: pager-proxy.queue_length=12387; oldest_message_age=00:34:21; consumer_lag=5800
Jon: I'm on-call. Taking lead. Marta can you confirm which customer(s) impacted?
Marta: acme-payments-prod is the one that opened a ticket (INC-12345). They say pages went out from their side but no oncall receipts.
Priya: I'm seeing the worker pool for pager-bridge stuck in STOPPING state during pre-stop. Attempting soft restart now: 
```
./ops/restart-bridge-worker.sh --grace 30
```
Zack: restart hung on socket close (tcp 10.0.0.12:443 -> 10.0.1.9:52768). going to force kill then bring back up with scaled replicas=4.
OpsOncall: Sent manual SMS to oncall list while we triage. Oncall acknowledged via SMS (:white_check_mark:)
IncidentBot: Created incident C-2026-045; severity=P1; annotating thread.
Jon: Standup conf in 5. Dial: https://zoom.company/meet/ops-1717 passcode 4821. I'll hop on.
Marta: Customer impact assessment so far: 8/12 recipients in acme oncall group did not receive the automated page. They reported increased time-to-ack for payment failover alerts.
Priya: Initial hypothesis: proxy backpressure triggered by malformed header trimming in release v1.2.3 -> caused consumer to choke on certain messages. Rolling back bridge image to v1.2.2 now.
Zack: Rolling back image + scale set:
```
kubectl set image deploy/pager-bridge pager-bridge=registry.redwood/pager-bridge:v1.2.2 --namespace=prod
kubectl scale deploy/pager-bridge --replicas=4 --namespace=prod
```
Zack: Force-killed the stuck pod, new pods coming up. Consumer lag dropping.
Priya: Started replay for queued messages with dedupe flag off for speed: /ops/replay-queue --queue pager-proxy --rate 300/s
Alex: Replaying ~2k messages. Watch for duplicates; alerting on duplicate-detection channel.
OpsOncall: Temporarily flipped incidentbot fallback to sms mode until proxy is stable: `/config set incidentbot.fallback=sms` (manual override)
Jon: Handoff: Priya, you're primary for the next 8 hours. I'll shadow for 10m then step out. @Priya please post the initial RCA stub.
Priya: Acknowledged. Will post RCA draft in channel once rollback validated. Monitoring metrics (p99 latency, queue depth).
Marta: Notifying CSM & support to proactively call impacted contacts. @Zack please prepare timeline for ACME and brief CS on what to say.
Zack: On it. Quick note: body payloads look intact; header trimming was the issue. ETA for full rollback and queue drain: ~32m.
IncidentBot: Annotation updated: severity=P1, status=mitigating, ticket=C-2026-045
Jon: Backlog down to ~400 and draining. New events are delivering. Keeping channel open until backlog=0 and rollback verified in canary.
Marta: Thanks team. Please add any post-incident follow-ups to the incident board. I'll start a customer communication draft and loop in legal if required.
Priya: Confirmed backlog drained to 0 at 03:41. Switching incidentbot fallback back to normal after one final verification pass.
OpsOncall: Verified incidentbot successfully posted a test page at 03:43 and received ack from oncall by SMS. Closing live mitigation; will keep channel for RCA writeup.
Jon: Good job. Handing off final write-up to Priya / Marta. :thumbsup:
